query:
INSERT INTO resources (source_id, file_path, path_hash, download_url, sha, size, ext)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
               ON CONFLICT (source_id, path_hash) DO UPDATE
               SET file_path = EXCLUDED.file_path,
                   download_url = EXCLUDED.download_url,
                   sha = EXCLUDED.sha,
                   size = EXCLUDED.size,
                   ext = EXCLUDED.ext,
                   updated_at = CASE WHEN resources.sha = EXCLUDED.sha THEN resources.updated_at ELSE NOW() END
               RETURNING (xmax = 0) as is_insert
